question: How can I customize the display names of tags in my API Reference documentation?
ground_truth: You can customize tag display names in your API Reference using the `x-displayName` extension in your OpenAPI specification. This allows you to control how section names appear in your generated documentation, including capitalization and creating user-friendly names. You can set display names directly in your spec file or in an overrides file. For example, you can change a tag named "task" to display as "Tasks" or "billing-and-payments" to display as "Billing and Payments". Alternatively, you can rename sections directly in your `docs.yml` file.
